subject: INITIALIZE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-09-02 (PB152). GR6's second sentence - with no INITIALIZE clause the content of items without predefined initialization values 'is undefined or specified by the implementor' - is what makes PicInfo.DefaultInitializer's space/zero seed a conforming choice, and it stays EXACTLY that seed: FillFor returns null when the clause is absent, so the whole no-clause population (every program in the corpus) is byte-unchanged. That invariant is a unit test rather than an assumption, because a regression in it is a corpus-wide wrong answer. The determination is documented in CONFORMANCE.md as required by 4.2.16.
